title: Триггер: Причина и Следствие
description: Раскрой скобки, используя Future Perfect Continuous.

items.sentence: I will be tired because I (work) ___ all day.
She will be hungry because she (not / eat) ___ for hours.
They will be dirty because they (play) ___ in the garden.
The ground will be wet because it (rain) ___.
He will be out of breath because he (run) ___.
